infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Hits uses your approximate location to find players near you. Your position is rounded to about two kilometres before it is saved, and the precise one is never stored.

plugins.photosPermission: Hits uses your photos so you can put a face to your name. Under 18, a parent approves the picture before anyone sees it.
plugins.cameraPermission: Hits uses your camera for your profile picture. Under 18, a parent approves it before anyone sees it.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Hits uses your approximate location to find players near you. Your position is rounded to about two kilometres before it is saved, and the precise one is never stored.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Hits uses your approximate location to find players near you. Your position is rounded to about two kilometres before it is saved, and the precise one is never stored.
